sn46.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca upavāṇo āyasmā ca sārīputto kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
sn46.8:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā upavāṇo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā upavāṇena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn46.8:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīya vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ etadavoca
sn46.8:2.1: jāneyya nu kho āvuso upavāṇa bhikkhu paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantīti.
sn46.8:2.2: jāneyya kho āvuso sārīputta bhikkhu paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantīti.
sn46.8:3.1: satisambojjhaṅgaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu ārabbhamāno pajānāmi cittañca me suvimuttaṃ thīnamiddhañca me susamūhataṃ uddhaccakukkuccañca me suppaṭivinītaṃ āraddhañca me viriyaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaromi no ca līnanti. pe.
sn46.8:3.2: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ āvuso bhikkhu ārabbhamāno pajānāmi cittañca me suvimuttaṃ thīnamiddhañca me susamūhataṃ uddhaccakukkuccañca me suppaṭivinītaṃ āraddhañca me viriyaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaromi no ca līnanti.
sn46.8:3.3: evaṃ kho āvuso sārīputta bhikkhu jāneyya paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantīti.
